name.description: Human-readable name of the method or model (e.g., 'GainForest BioClassifier').

version.description: Version string of the method or model (e.g., '2.1.0').

references.description: URIs to papers, documentation, or repositories describing this method.

modelCheckpoint.description: Identifier for the specific model checkpoint used (e.g., date or hash).

methodInfo.description: Provenance metadata describing the method used to produce an evaluation.

cid.description: CID pinning the exact version of the target record.

subjectRef.description: Reference to a target record that is being evaluated.

field.description: The field name that has the quality issue.

severity.description: Severity level of the quality issue.

qualityFlag.description: A single data quality flag indicating an issue with a specific field.

rank.description: Rank position among candidates (1 = best match).

gbifTaxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxonomy key for the candidate.

scientificName.description: Full scientific name of the candidate taxon.

candidateTaxon.description: A candidate taxon identification with confidence score and rank.

remarks.description: Additional notes about the species identification.

candidates.description: Ranked list of candidate species identifications.

inputFeature.description: Which feature of the subject record was used as input (e.g., 'mediaEvidence').

speciesIdResult.description: AI or human species recognition result with ranked candidate identifications.

flags.description: List of quality issues found in the record.

remarks.description: Additional notes about the quality assessment.

dataQualityResult.description: Data quality assessment result with per-field quality flags.

measurementResult.description: Derived measurements produced by an evaluator from source data (e.g., remote sensing metrics).

measurementType.description: The nature of the measurement (e.g., 'canopy cover', 'NDVI', 'tree height').

measurementUnit.description: The units for the measurement value (e.g., '%', 'm', 'kg').

measurementMethod.description: Description of the method used to obtain the measurement.

derivedMeasurement.description: A single measurement derived by an evaluator from source data.

status.description: Verification status: confirmed, rejected, or uncertain.

verifiedBy.description: Name of the person who performed the verification.

verifiedByID.description: Persistent identifier (e.g., ORCID) of the verifier.

suggestedCorrections.description: Suggested corrections if the original identification was rejected or uncertain.

verificationResult.description: Expert verification result for a previous identification or evaluation.

classificationResult.description: Generic categorical classification result (e.g., conservation priority, habitat type).

schema.description: Shared type definitions for decentralized evaluator services. Evaluators attach structured, typed evaluation data to records (a more sophisticated evolution of the labeler pattern).
